# Publishing Checklist

Use this checklist before making the repository public.

## Required

- Choose and add a real `LICENSE` file.
- Replace placeholder GitHub URLs in `pyproject.toml`.
- Confirm the package name `wkanno` is the final public name.
- Run the local test and lint commands successfully.
- Perform one live authenticated end-to-end smoke test on a fresh annotation.

## Recommended

- Create a GitHub repository description and topics.
- Add a short screenshot or terminal demo to the README.
- Tag the first release as `v0.1.0` only after the public metadata is finalized.
- Decide whether a PyPI release is desired or whether GitHub install is sufficient.
